q: You report the average of 40 incomes, and one of them is huge. Which average should you use?
why: The median isn't pulled by one extreme value.

q: If P(positive | disease) is high, then P(disease | positive) is high too.
why: Myth. With a rare disease, most positives can still be false alarms.

A strong correlation proves that one thing causes the other.
why: Myth. A third factor or reverse causation can produce the same pattern.
